title: US designer Bob Mackie, known for Hollywood glamour, dies at 87
summary: American fashion designer Bob Mackie, whose eye-catching dresses were worn by Cher, Tina Turner, Sabrina Carpenter and countless others in Hollywood's glitterati, died Monday. He was 87.
